snippet.title: Carrie Sheffield
snippet.description:
Carrie Sheffield is a columnist and broadcaster in Washington DC. She earned a full-tuition Harvard scholarship, managed billions of dollars in risk at Wall Street firms, and competed in a Miss USA system beauty pageant. A journalist and former White House correspondent, she challenged the Muslim Brotherhood in Egypt and testified as an economic expert before the US Congress. Carrie achieved all this while overcoming a life of extreme poverty and psychological, spiritual, and sexual abuse. A recovered agnostic, Carrie eventually found peace and anchoring in Christianity. Carrie shares insights on networks like CNN, MSNBC, Fox News, CBS News, CNBC, BBC, and more. 

Don't miss Carrie Sheffield's newsletter: https://carriesheffield.substack.com/ Now Available!,
And be sure to get your copy of "Motorhome Prophecies": https://www.hachettebookgroup.com/titles/carrie-sheffield/motorhome-prophecies/9781546004387/

snippet.title: Василь Климчук
snippet.description:
Друзі, категорично вас вітаю на своєму авторському каналі. Мене звати Василь Климчук. Я професійний журналіст. Саме це визначає мої стандарти у подачі інформації. Я не знаходжусь на утриманні жодного політичного чи фінансового угрупування країни, тому дозволяю собі бути неупередженим і об"єктивним.
Якщо Вам треба справді знати що навколо відбувається без нав"язаного розуміння - Вам сюди.
Залюбки пропоную Вам медійний антисептик аби Ви були дезінфіковані у медійному просторі.
І чим нас більше на каналі, тим легше нам впливати на тих, від кого залежить щось залежить у нашому житті.
Правда, інколи, на каналі Ви знайдете мої відео про мандрівки. Обожнюю автівки, нові країни і нові знання.
ДЯКУЮ, ЩО ВИ НА КАНАЛІ ВАСИЛЬ КЛИМЧУК!

snippet.title: Cleo Abram
snippet.description:
Video journalist making optimistic tech explainers. Huge If True.

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/cleoabram
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@cleoabram 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/cleoabram

If you'd like to sponsor a Huge If True episode, reach out at the email below.

If you're looking for my bio, here it is:
Cleo Abram is a video journalist who produces Huge If True, an optimistic show about science and technology. Huge If True is an antidote to the doom and gloom, helping a wide audience see better futures they can help build. In each episode, Cleo dives deep into one innovation that could shape the future. She has explored humanoid robots at Boston Dynamics, supersonic planes at NASA, quantum computers at IBM, the Large Hadron Collider at CERN, and more. Previously, Cleo was a video producer at Vox and directed for Explained on Netflix. She was the host of Vox’s first ever daily show, Answered, as well as co-host of Vox’s YouTube Originals show, Glad You Asked.

snippet.title: Makhdoom Shahab-ud-Din
snippet.description:
Award-winning journalist | Influencer | Storyteller |  | Author of "Pakistan Unveiled" | Erasmus Mundus Journalism scholar

Makhdoom Shahab-ud-Din is an award-winning journalist from Pakistan currently based in United Kingdom. He has previously worked as an Anchorperson at national level news channels including PTV News and Hum News. He writes articles and columns for leading newspapers of Pakistan including Daily Times and Pakistan Observer. He received Agahi Journalist of the Year 2019 award for his article on Sexual and Reproductive Health Rights in Pakistan. He is currently an Erasmus Mundus Journalism Scholar based in Europe. He has been featured by various media outlets across the world and inside Pakistan for his stories.

snippet.title: Prof. Adam Wielomski. Naukowo o polityce
snippet.description:
Szanowni Państwo,
Na kanale tym, i dzięki niemu, chcę:
1/ Zamieszczać rozmowy o ważnych tematach, dyskusje o książkach, etc.
2/ Minimum raz w tygodniu nagrać i zamieścić wykład z nauk o polityce.
3/ Wydawać napisane przystępnym językiem, ale posiadające wartość naukową, książki o tematyce politologicznej.

Niestety, wszystko to kosztuje i czas i pieniądze. Stąd moja prośba o wsparcie finansowe, gdyż udostępniam wiedzę uniwersytecką całkowicie za darmo, licząc jedynie na Wasze wsparcie. Mój projekt edukacyjny jest w tej chwili w Waszych rękach. Każda wpłata to nie tylko pomoc finansowa, lecz i znak, że to co tutaj robię znajduje Odbiorców i że jest to komukolwiek potrzebne. snippet.title: Tomi Lahren
snippet.description:
I took the world by storm with my "Red, White, Blue & Unfiltered Final Thoughts"  following the terrorist attack in Chattanooga, TN. At just 23-years-old, I have more to say.  I'm a different breed of political commentator. I'm not afraid to tell it like it is. I will get to "the point" with issues that matter most, from the Middle East to the Southern border. Political correctness is intellectual dishonesty. America is stronger when we come together. Family, faith, hard work and love of country are innate to all Americans. Some just need to be reminded. That's my job.

The only thing I get on my knees to do is pray, then I get on my feet and get to work. God Bless America. 

Follow me on Twitter and Instagram @tomilahren. Let's start the conversation.
